pictures.name: CSC1-Sister-Arrives
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. A mountain road in the Italian hills below Monte Cassino, around 540 AD, late morning. In the middle, Saint Scholastica, a gentle woman of about sixty with a warm smile, in a black Benedictine habit and veil with a white wimple, walks up the path with two younger nuns in black habits, smiling, a walking stick in hand. Ahead at a small stone house, Saint Benedict, a tall man of about sixty with a long grey beard and a tonsure, in a black Benedictine habit, comes out to meet her with open arms, two monks behind him. Green slopes, gold sunlight, deep blue mountain shadows. Joy of reunion. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSC2-Talking-Evening
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. Inside a small stone house near Monte Cassino at dusk, around 540 AD: a rough wooden table with bread, a jug and two cups, one oil lamp. Saint Scholastica, a gentle woman of about sixty with a warm smile, in a black Benedictine habit and veil with a white wimple, and Saint Benedict, a tall man of about sixty with a long grey beard and a tonsure, in a black Benedictine habit, sit across from each other, leaning in, deep in happy conversation, faces lit gold. Through the small window the sky is deep blue and clear, with the first star. The two of them in the middle. Warmth, understanding, love between a brother and sister. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSC3-Please-Stay
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same small stone house at night. Saint Benedict, a tall man of about sixty with a long grey beard and a tonsure, in a black Benedictine habit, has risen from the table and stands by the door pulling up his hood, firm but kind. Saint Scholastica, a gentle woman of about sixty with a warm smile, in a black Benedictine habit and veil with a white wimple, still seated, reaches across the table toward him, pleading gently, her face full of longing. One oil lamp gives gold light, deep blue shadows. The clear starry sky in the window. The two in the middle. Tender tension. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSC4-Storm-Breaks
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same small stone house at night, seen from inside: Saint Scholastica, a gentle woman of about sixty with a warm smile, in a black Benedictine habit and veil with a white wimple, sits at the table with her joined hands resting on the wood and her head bowed onto them, praying. Behind her, the open doorway and window blaze white with lightning, sheets of rain pour down, and Saint Benedict, a tall man of about sixty with a long grey beard and a tonsure, in a black Benedictine habit, stands in the doorway, drenched, staring out in astonishment. Flickering gold lamplight, deep blue storm. Drama, wonder, a quiet hidden smile. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSC5-Benedict-Stays
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The same small stone house late at night, rain streaming down the window. Saint Benedict, a tall man of about sixty with a long grey beard and a tonsure, in a black Benedictine habit, has sat back down at the table, laughing and shaking his head in surrender, his hood thrown back; Saint Scholastica, a gentle woman of about sixty with a warm smile, in a black Benedictine habit and veil with a white wimple, smiles at him, triumphant and loving. A fresh candle burns between them, bread and cups on the table. Warm gold candlelight, deep blue rainy night outside. The two in the middle. Joy, affection, peace. No text, no letters, no logos.

pictures.name: CSC6-Dove-Rises
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight. The tower of the monastery of Monte Cassino at dawn, around 543 AD. Saint Benedict, a tall man of about sixty with a long grey beard and a tonsure, in a black Benedictine habit, stands at a high window seen from behind, looking up as a single white dove rises into a pale gold and blue morning sky above the green mountains. Peaceful mist in the valley below. Gentle grief and hope, peace. No text, no letters, no logos.
